responsibility: Implements dominator-tree-based GIMPLE optimizations that combine local value simplification, copy/constant equivalence tracking, edge-derived conditional facts, available-expression lookup, jump simplification, and limited redundant store elimination. Walking the dominator tree, it records equivalences from PHIs, statements, and incoming edges, folds and propagates conditions, removes redundant computations and stores, updates EH and noreturn CFG effects, and drives the classic tree SSA DOM optimization pass built around scoped availability tables rather than global PRE.
same_name_distinction: This is the dominator-optimization implementation file, containing the DOM pass logic for equivalence tracking, redundant-expression elimination, condition simplification, and limited store elimination while walking the dominator tree. In contrast, gcc/tree-ssa-dom.h exports only a tiny helper interface rather than the pass machinery.
